newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends flat in low volume.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends flat in low volume.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 493-504 per dollar on Sunday, little changed from opening at 495-505 and from 498-500 at the previous close amid very thin interbank trade ahead of the New Year, dealers said.
"The lev ended flat as banks serviced sporadic bids for light foreign currency volumes from clients and interbank trade was virtually nil in the afternoon," one trader said.
Spot deals were struck just above 500 levs per dollar while deals with a value date on Monday were struck near 495, another dealer said.
The value date of today's spot deals was January 3 as the local forex market will be closed from Tuesday through Thursday for the New Year, dealers said.
